title: v1_133
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.133 Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vs-code), [X](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=533687), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/vscode.dev) --- _Release date: August 12, 2026_ --- Welcome to the 1.133 release of Visual Studio Code. This release gives you more flexibility in Claude sessions, keeps long chats easier to follow, and refreshes local HTML previews as you work. * [Change model provider for Claude sessions](#mix-anthropic-and-copilot-models-in-claude-sessions): Switch providers between turns without reconfiguring the agent host. * [Agents window without GitHub sign-in](#open-the-agents-window-without-github-sign-in-experimental): Use Claude with your existing API key when GitHub sign-in is unavailable. * [Auto-reload HTML files](#auto-reload-html-files-in-the-integrated-browser): Preview HTML changes immediately without manual refresh. Happy Coding! ---
